newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan plans 2-yr note auction on Thursday--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan plans 2-yr note auction on Thursday--MOF.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) plans to offer two-year government notes through a price-competitive auction on Thursday, a MOF official said on Wednesday.
Traders said the MOF's offer volume is likely to be 120 billion yen, unchanged from the previous issue, and that the coupon rate is likely to be set at 1.1 percent.
When the MOF last auctioned two-year notes on May 23, it offered 120 billion yen worth of 1.0 percent notes. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
